Name: Neariah, Son of Shemaiah
Summary: Son of Shemaiah son of Shechaniah and father of Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:22: Son of Shemaiah son of Shechaniah and father of Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Neariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
